description: Frontend: make EVERY failure mode in the chat send path VISIBLE so a send can never again be a silent no-op, and make the composer behave like a real chat input (Enter to send / Shift+Enter newline). This is the diagnostics-first half of Issue 2 plus all of Issue 1. Today (1) conversations.ts sendMessage does `await sendMessageCmd(...)` with NO try/catch, so a rejected send_message IPC call (e.g. the backend build failure fixed in FEAT-001, or any future rejection) is swallowed and the Composer's `void sendMessage(content)` discards it: no message, no error; (2) the messageError reducer only flips an existing message to status:'error' and DROPS the display-safe `message` text, and MessageBubble shows a generic 'This message failed to generate.' with no reason; (3) there is no user-visible 'sending…/failed' affordance and the user's own message is not echoed until the backend MessageStarted(User) event arrives, so a rejected send shows nothing at all. Fix all three, and add Enter/Shift+Enter to the Composer.
steps: Composer.tsx (Issue 1): add an onKeyDown handler to the <textarea>. On Enter WITHOUT Shift: `event.preventDefault(); submit();`. On Enter WITH Shift: do nothing (let the default newline insert). Guard IME composition so CJK input is not swallowed: early-return if `event.nativeEvent.isComposing` OR `event.keyCode === 229`. Keep the existing Send button and form onSubmit working unchanged. Keep the disabled guard (activeConversationId === null).

conversations.ts (Issue 2 visibility): stop swallowing send failures. Add transient send state to the store so a failed send is visible even before/without any MessageStarted event. Recommended shape: a `sendError: string | null` field (display-safe) plus a `sendState: 'idle'|'sending'|'failed'`. In sendMessage: set sendState:'sending', clear sendError; wrap `await sendMessageCmd(...)` in try/catch; on reject set sendState:'failed' and sendError to a display-safe string derived from the caught error (mirror providers.ts load() lastError extraction: stringify the CommandError {code,message} or Error.message); on success set sendState back to 'idle' (the streamed events then drive the reply). Clear sendError/sendState on the next successful send attempt. Ensure the store reset shapes in tests get the new fields (see chat.test.tsx resetStores and app.test.tsx setState blocks).

conversations.ts (Issue 2 visibility): make the messageError reducer carry the reason. In applyCoreEvent 'messageError', in addition to setting status:'error', replace the message content with the display-safe error text so the reason is shown, e.g. set content to { type: 'text', text: event.message } when the current content is empty/streaming-placeholder (do NOT clobber a fully streamed reply that then errored on finalize; if the message already has non-empty text, keep it and rely on status:'error'). Keep the id-match/activeConversation guards. If the errored messageId is not yet in the store (no placeholder seeded), append a new assistant message with role:'assistant', status:'error', content text = event.message so the error is never dropped.

MessageBubble.tsx (Issue 2 visibility): when message.status === 'error', render the actual message text (the error reason now stored in content) inside the role="alert" block instead of the hardcoded 'This message failed to generate.' Keep role="alert". If content text is empty, fall back to the generic string.

Composer.tsx or a small sibling (Issue 2 visibility): render a visible, aria-live send-status affordance driven by the store's sendState/sendError, e.g. a

shown when sendState==='failed' reading `Failed to send: {sendError}`. Use var(--ah-danger) styling. This guarantees a rejected send_message (which produces no CoreEvents at all) is still surfaced to the user.
types/index.ts: no CoreEvent SHAPE change is required (messageError already carries `message`). Do not alter the CoreEvent union. Only the store/UI consume the existing field.
Styling: add .composer__send-error and, if needed, a .message-bubble__error tweak in app.css using existing var(--ah-*) tokens (danger color, spacing). Keep prettier-clean.

Tests (chat.test.tsx + conversations.test.ts): (a) plain Enter in the Composer textarea calls the store sendMessage (invoke 'send_message') and clears the draft; (b) Shift+Enter does NOT send (invoke not called with send_message) and preserves/extends the draft; (c) an IME-composing Enter (nativeEvent.isComposing true, or keyCode 229) does NOT send; (d) a send whose send_message IPC REJECTS surfaces a visible failed-to-send affordance (mock invoke to reject for 'send_message'); assert with findBy*/waitFor and that sendState==='failed'/sendError set; (e) a messageError CoreEvent renders the actual error reason text in the alert (not the generic string), and an errored messageId with no prior placeholder still appends a visible error bubble; (f) a normal streamed turn (messageStarted assistant -> messageDelta -> messageComplete) appends assistant deltas (extend the existing streaming test if needed). Mock invoke for EVERY command the mounted component calls with well-formed shapes (send_message, get_messages returning [], and for any App-level test the full routeInvoke set). Update resetStores()/setState blocks in chat.test.tsx and app.test.tsx to include the new store fields so nothing reads undefined.
acceptance_criteria: Pressing Enter (no Shift, not composing) in the composer sends the message and clears the draft; Shift+Enter inserts a newline and does not send; IME-composition Enter does not send.
A rejected send_message IPC call surfaces a visible, role=alert 'Failed to send: <reason>' affordance driven by store sendState/sendError (never a silent no-op).
A messageError CoreEvent shows the actual display-safe reason text in the chat (role=alert), and an errored message with no seeded placeholder still appears as a visible error bubble.
A normal streamed turn still appends assistant deltas and toggles the StreamingIndicator.

New/updated vitest cases cover Enter/Shift+Enter/IME, the rejected-send affordance, the messageError-reason rendering, and the streamed-turn happy path; all mounted components have ALL invoked commands mocked with well-formed shapes.
tsc strict, eslint (no unused vars), and prettier --check are clean.
verification: Run `(cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run build)` (tsc strict + vite) and confirm no type errors (CI/where network available).
Run `(cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm test)` and confirm the new and existing chat/app/conversations tests pass.
Run `(cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run lint)` and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` and confirm clean.
findings: Implemented frontend-only (no CoreEvent shape change). Composer.tsx: added onKeyDown to the textarea (plain Enter -> preventDefault + submit; Shift+Enter -> default newline; IME guard early-returns when event.nativeEvent.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229; Enter-only guard via event.key !== 'Enter'). Kept Send button, form onSubmit, and the disabled (activeConversationId===null) guard unchanged. conversations.ts: added SendState type ('idle'|'sending'|'failed') plus store fields sendState/sendError (initialized idle/null); sendMessage now sets sending + clears sendError, wraps the awaited sendMessageCmd in try/catch, on reject sets failed + display-safe sendError (mirrors providers.ts load(): e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)), on success resets to idle/null. messageError reducer now carries the reason: if the messageId is not in the store it APPENDS a new assistant message {status:'error', content text = event.message}; if present it sets status 'error' and replaces content with the reason text ONLY when the current content is an empty text placeholder (a non-empty streamed reply keeps its text). MessageBubble.tsx: on status==='error' renders the stored content text in the role='alert' block, falling back to 'This message failed to generate.' when there is no text; ContentBody is rendered only for non-error messages to avoid duplicate text. Composer renders a role='alert' .composer__send-error reading 'Failed to send: {sendError}' when sendState==='failed' (the ONLY visible signal for a rejected send_message, which emits no CoreEvents). app.css: added .composer__send-error styled with var(--ah-danger)/var(--ah-*) tokens. Tests: updated resetStores()/setState blocks in chat.test.tsx, conversations.test.ts, and both/all setState blocks in app.test.tsx to include sendState/sendError; added chat.test.tsx cases (plain Enter sends + clears, Shift+Enter no-send + preserves draft, IME isComposing/keyCode 229 no-send, rejected send_message surfaces the failed affordance + store state, MessageBubble renders stored reason vs generic fallback, MessageList appends a visible error bubble for an un-seeded messageError); added conversations.test.ts cases (messageError carries reason into empty placeholder, preserves a non-empty streamed reply, appends when un-seeded, rejected send sets failed/sendError, successful send resets idle + clears prior error). VERIFICATION DEFERRED: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox has no npm registry access and node_modules is absent (npm ci --offline fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND), so npm run build (tsc+vite), npm test (vitest), and prettier --check CANNOT run here; validated by static review against tsc strict, eslint no-floating-promises (void fire-and-forget) / no-unused-vars, and prettier printWidth=100/2-space/double-quote/trailing-comma conventions. Left the pre-existing modified FEAT-001.json (status bump for the already-committed backend fix) untouched; did not touch embedded-engine feature-flagging, provider diagnostics, or the model picker.
